purpose: Separate financial generalization stress-check and exploratory controlled execution-allowance comparison

holdout.design: fresh deterministic within public specification; designed without inspecting candidate source/outcomes; freeze before evaluation
holdout.qualification: all55 Python reference outputs compared to independently recalculated spreadsheet outputs plus predeclared feature witnesses
holdout.scoreboard: separate holdout result, not replacing original45

execution_gate: Do not dispatch until holdout expected results fully qualify; candidate holdout errors are reportable results, not oracle failure. Do not modify frozen candidate or feed results back.
interpretation_limit: One randomized pair remains exploratory, not a reliable success-rate estimate or isolated causal proof across repeated generations.
